SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.regist_dt DESC) AS row_num, u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.email_adres, u.moblphon_no, u.dept_cd, d.dept_nm, u.user_sttus_cd, c.code_nm AS user_sttus_cd_nm, u.jbgd_cd, u.jssfc_cd, r.role_nm, TO_CHAR(u.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regist_dt FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_dept d ON u.dept_cd = d.dept_cd LEFT JOIN tb_cmmn_code_detail c ON u.user_sttus_cd = c.code AND c.code_id = 'USER_STTUS' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ur.user_id, r.role_nm FROM tb_user_role ur INNER JOIN tb_role r ON ur.role_cd = r.role_cd ) r ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.email_adres, u.moblphon_no, u.dept_cd, d.dept_nm, u.user_sttus_cd, c1.code_nm AS user_sttus_cd_nm, u.sexdstn_cd, c2.code_nm AS sexdstn_cd_nm, TO_CHAR(u.brthdy, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS brthdy, u.jbgd_cd, c3.code_nm AS jbgd_cd_nm, u.jssfc_cd, c4.code_nm AS jssfc_cd_nm, TO_CHAR(u.join_de, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS join_de, TO_CHAR(u.password_change_de, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS password_change_de, TO_CHAR(u.last_login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login_dt, u.login_fail_co, u.acnt_lock_yn, u.use_yn, u.register_id, TO_CHAR(u.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regist_dt, u.updusr_id, TO_CHAR(u.updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updt_dt, r.role_cd, r.role_nm FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_dept d ON u.dept_cd = d.dept_cd LEFT JOIN tb_cmmn_code_detail c1 ON u.user_sttus_cd = c1.code AND c1.code_id = 'USER_STTUS' LEFT JOIN tb_cmmn_code_detail c2 ON u.sexdstn_cd = c2.code AND c2.code_id = 'SEXDSTN' LEFT JOIN tb_cmmn_code_detail c3 ON u.jbgd_cd = c3.code AND c3.code_id = 'JGBD' LEFT JOIN tb_cmmn_code_detail c4 ON u.jssfc_cd = c4.code AND c4.code_id = 'JSSFC' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ur.user_id, ur.role_cd, r.role_nm FROM tb_user_role ur INNER JOIN tb_role r ON ur.role_cd = r.role_cd ) r ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
